name: Perspective: Funnel & Landing Page Builder
description: Let Claude build, launch, and optimize your funnels, landing pages, and forms in Perspective — the platform for high-converting funnels, landing pages, quiz funnels, and lead-capture forms. From a single prompt, Claude can design and build a funnel or landing page, publish it live to your own domain, connect lead capture and CRM, launch email nurture sequences, and read real-time analytics to find and fix your conversion rate. Built for lead generation, marketing campaigns, webinars, coaches, and agencies running ads for themselves or clients.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Perspective: Funnel & Landing Page Builder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Perspective: Funnel & Landing Page Builder to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.perspective.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Perspective: Funnel & Landing Page Builder MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Perspective: Funnel & Landing Page Builder lists 35 MCP tools, including create_brand, create_funnel, create_sequence, finalize_image_upload, get_brand, get_chart_metrics, get_contact, get_crm_properties, get_email_instructions, get_email_step_html, get_funnel_events, and get_funnel_job_status.
